    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AuditableEntity
    Extends BaseEntity to provide auditing capabilities.
    BaseEntity
    A base class for JPA entities that provides a universally unique identifier (UUID) as a primary key.
    PageDto<T>
    A DTO representing a page of data.
    PageParams
    Spring Web query parameter binding class for pagination requests.
    PageSpec
    Framework-agnostic specification for requesting a page of data with optional sorting.
    PaginationDto
    A DTO representing pagination information.
    Paginator
    Converts framework-agnostic PageSpec requests into Spring Data Pageables, and Spring Data Pages back into framework-agnostic PageDtos.
    Paginator.Config<S>
    Settings for a Paginator, adjusted by the customizer passed to Paginator.of(Class, Class, Consumer).
    PagingWebAutoConfiguration
    Spring Boot auto-configuration for jpa-utils' Spring MVC support: registers a SortDirectionConverter so that PageParams binds sortDirection case-insensitively.
    Searchable
    Marks a field or getter method as searchable, enabling it to be automatically included in search queries.
    SearchableRepository<S,I>
    A repository that supports searching.
    Searchables
    Utility class for building JPA Criteria API predicates based on fields marked with Searchable.
    SortDirection
    Enumeration representing the direction for sorting query results.
    SortDirectionConverter
    Converts a request parameter into a SortDirection, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, so clients may send asc, DESC or Desc.
    SortPropertyProvider
    Functional interface for providing JPA property paths from sort enum constants.
    UnknownSortByValueException
    Exception thrown when an unknown sort by value is provided that cannot be resolved to a valid enum constant.
